messages:
Ethan Wu: Morning—I'm starting today. Quick security question: I travel a lot for work, often use personal iPhone and MacBook. Is there any exemption for not enrolling my iPhone into MDM? Concerned about personal data.

People Ops: Welcome Ethan! :wave: Short answer: mobile devices still need basic protections but we can minimize data control. For iOS we require enrollment in Redwood Mobile Device Management (Profile only, no full device wipe without explicit consent). It enforces a passcode, device encryption, and blocks jailbroken devices. It won't access personal photos/messages.

Security: Adding context: MDM on iOS uses a configuration profile (supervised vs unsupervised differ). We only ask for unsupervised enrollment for BYOD which grants policy control (passcode, VPN, certs) but not full device control. If you need a company iPhone for travel, file hardware request—we can issue temporary devices for high-travel roles.

Ethan Wu: Appreciate the clarification. What about phishing sims? I worry about clicking something by accident while on mobile. Are mobile users treated differently?

Onboarding Bot: Phishing sim window for cohort: new-hires (0-30 days). Reminder: treat all external-looking emails as potential phish. Use the "Report Phish" option or forward to security@redwood.com.

IT Support: For macOS, FileVault is mandatory and MDM enforces Gatekeeper settings. If you don't want to enroll your personal Mac, request a company laptop—we'll image it with corp profile. For iPhone MDM, you can review the profile before installing: Settings -> General -> VPN & Device Management. DM me if you want to walk through it.

Security: Phish sims are instrumented to track clicks and credential submissions. If you click a simulated link, you'll be immediately shown a learning page and assigned a 15-min remediation micro-course. Repeated failures (3 in 6 months) trigger a short conversation with your manager; no punitive action otherwise.

Ethan Wu: Good to know. Is there any way to opt out of sims if they're disruptive during travel?

People Ops: We can delay targeting for a new hire by up to 2 weeks on request if travel or onboarding conflicts exist. To request delay, reply with "sims-delay: <reason>" and tag @People Ops.

Ethan Wu: sims-delay: international travel through next week, patchy email access. Thanks!

Onboarding Bot: Delay request received for Ethan Wu; sims targeting moved +14 days.

IT Support: One more note—if you have corporate Slack sessions on your phone, enable screen lock and use FaceID/TouchID for 1Password. If you plan to enroll Mac, run:
```bash
curl -sSf https://mdm.redwood.com/install-mac.sh | sudo bash
```
Then reboot and confirm in Okta. Ping me if that fails.

Ethan Wu: Thanks all. I'll request a loaner iPhone for travel and enroll my Mac when I get to the office.
